== Notes ==
* The conditions are applied to the target before being removed from the foes in the area, so [[Fevered Dreams]] will not re-apply the conditions.
* Can be used for an AoE [[Fragility]] spike.

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Hypochondriasis|Hypochondria]] is the excessive preoccupation or worry about having a serious illness.
